description: Spine Toolbox is a Python graphical environment from the Spine Tools community for assembling modelling workflows and managing scenario data. It connects databases, data imports, processing tools and model runs through a visible workflow, with project and version-control support. Inputs and outputs depend on the connected tools, while shared databases organise modelling parameters and scenarios. Coverage is global and configurable, with no fixed geographic resolution or study period. Public code is free under LGPL-3.0; documentation and graphics use CC BY-SA 4.0. Installation guidance recommends pipx and documents platform-specific requirements. A limitation is that the embedded Python environment is not intended to run every user tool, and Anaconda and older Windows installers have documented support problems. Spine Toolbox can organise energy-system studies around SpineOpt (model-spineopt) and other models. Existing Mopo and Baltic dataset records link to the toolbox as an external dependency, not covering this software distribution. The 2022 SoftwareX article describes the implementation. No database or model workflow was executed.
